proof.method: Re-read the new edition text in full against the ten prior findings' fixes, re-read every manuscript file the fixes touched (00-about-this-book.md, 01-, 02-, 03-, 05-, 06-, 08-, 09-, 10-glossary.md) and the evidence packet's Figma/Adobe XD passage, re-verified the three-project list and the course-6 Figma/Adobe XD claim against coursera.org (WebFetch/WebSearch), re-checked the Gray et al. and Nielsen-heuristic wording against the manuscript's own bibliography and Nielsen (1994), and re-ran the style-guide adverb/contraction scan across the whole new text to confirm no fix introduced a new violation; also traced the two new value-proposition/user-story answers (Ch1 Q9, Ch2 Q9) against the rest of the running example for invented facts. For the f16 re-fix and the f17 running-head fix, ran full-text diffs between successive edition texts to confirm each changed only what was claimed, then spot-checked odd- and even-page running heads across the whole document (a whole-document grep for stray "CONTENTS"/"ANSWERS" strings) to confirm no stale running head remained anywhere, including in the back-matter chapters (About this book, A study plan, Glossary, References) that had no visible diff.
